The upstream file is unmodified. The production wrapper enables RV32IM,
uses local block RAM for instructions and an external upstream PCPI fast
multiplier with EXTRA_MUL_FFS=1, EXTRA_INSN_FFS=0. Image operations execute
inside the FPGA. This CPU does not control or replace the ESP32 firmware.
